changes.before: If label becomes an empty string instead of null, what happens to label ?? "Untitled"?
changes.after: Choose a backup value when text is missing.

before: null means no object value is present. A string? annotation says the string reference may be null. It is different from "", which is an existing empty string.
The ?? operator uses its right side only when its left side is null. Empty text does not trigger this fallback.
The ?. operator accesses a member only if the receiver is non-null. label?.Length produces a nullable integer: a length when present, or null when absent.
label?.Length ?? 0 safely produces zero for an absent label. It also produces zero for an empty label, but for a different reason: the empty string has length zero.
Expected behavior from this example: Untitled on the first line, then 0. This expected result is a reasoned prediction until a compiler test is recorded.

Optional local transfer task: Compare null, an empty string, and "Sky". Predict the fallback text and length result for all three. You may trace it on paper if no C# toolchain is installed; reading completion does not certify a run.
after: null means no value is present. It is different from empty text, which is a string with no letters.
The question mark in string? says this text value may be null. This helps C# warn about places where missing text could cause an error.
The ?? operator chooses the right-hand value only when the left-hand value is null. That right-hand value is a backup.

The ?. operator reads a member only when the value exists. Here, label?.Length gives null when label is missing. Length counts the string's UTF-16 units, the pieces C# uses to store text; some visible symbols need more than one unit.
The program prints Untitled, then 0 on the next line. Both lines use their backup because label is null.
An empty string is still present. The first ?? would keep that empty text. Its Length is already zero, so the second line would still show 0.

before.question: If label becomes an empty string instead of null, what happens to label ?? "Untitled"?
choices: It returns the empty string, because only null triggers the fallback.
It returns Untitled because empty and null are identical.
It throws because empty text has no Length.
before.explanation: An empty string is still a present value, so ?? keeps it.

after.question: If label holds empty text, what does label ?? "Untitled" choose?
after.explanation: Only null chooses the backup. Empty text is a value that exists.
